arguments.sql: SELECT c.card_brand, COUNT(*) AS labelled_transactions, SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_transactions, 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id GROUP BY c.card_brand ORDER BY fraud_rate DESC, c.card_brand
arguments.explanation: For each card brand, this shows how many transactions have a fraud label, how many of those are fraud, and the fraud rate as a fraction of labelled transactions. Brands are listed from highest fraud rate to lowest.
assumptions: The fraud rate is worked out over labelled transactions only. Transactions with no label are left out.
